description_zh: 支持添加、删除财务关联权限点
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi modify-account-relation --relation-type enterprise_group --relation-operation ADD --parent-user-id 1738376485192612 --child-nick '用户昵称' --child-user-id 1512996702208737 --request-id request_id --role-codes trusteeship --permission-codes SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY --relation-id 51463 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountRelation

parameters.help_en: The relationship type. Currently, only enterprise_group is supported
parameters.name: relation_type

parameters.help_en:
The action to perform. Valid values:

ADD: Adds the permission.

DELETE: Deletes the permission
parameters.help_zh:
修改动作
添加：ADD
删除：DELETE
parameters.name: relation_operation

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: parent_user_id

parameters.help_en: The display name. This name is shown on the page to help you identify the use case of the account
parameters.help_zh: 显示名称，用于页面显示，便于明确账号使用场景
parameters.name: child_nick

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.name: child_user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the request. This ID is used to mark a request and troubleshoot issues
parameters.help_zh: 请求唯一标识，用于标记一次请求，便于定位问题
parameters.name: request_id

parameters.help_en:
The permissions that can be modified. Valid values:

SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY: Allow synchronizing the credit control identity with the linked account.

SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_DISCOUNT_POLICY_TO_TARGET: Allow synchronizing discounts with the linked account.

FORBID_WITHDRAW_CASH: Prohibit the linked account from withdrawing its balance.

FORBID_MANAGE_INVOICE: Prohibit the linked account from managing invoices.

CHECK_FINANCE_INFO: View information about the account linking relationship.

MANAGE_TARGET_INVOICE: Manage invoices for the linked account.

CHECK_TARGET_CONSUMPTION: View the consumption details of the linked account
parameters.help_zh:
支持修改的权限点如下：

允许同步信控身份给关联账号：SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY
允许同步优惠给关联账号：SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_DISCOUNT_POLICY_TO_TARGET
禁止关联账户余额提现：FORBID_WITHDRAW_CASH
禁止关联账户管理发票：FORBID_MANAGE_INVOICE
请求查看财务关联信息：CHECK_FINANCE_INFO
允许管理目标发票：MANAGE_TARGET_INVOICE
允许查看关联账户消费信息：CHECK_TARGET_CONSUMPTION
parameters.name: permission_codes

parameters.help_en: The relationship ID. Obtain this value from the relationId field returned by the QueryRelationList operation
parameters.help_zh: 关系ID。取值从QueryRelationList接口返回的结果字段relationId获取
parameters.name: relation_id
